title: Automated Container Image Lifecycle for E-commerce Microservices
business: A mid-sized e-commerce platform managing dozens of independent microservices that require rapid, consistent deployment cycles.
problem: Manual build processes lead to inconsistent container images, environment drift, and significant developer overhead when preparing artifacts for production.
solution: Cloud Build provides a managed platform to automate the creation of containerized build steps, ensuring that every code commit triggers a standardized, repeatable artifact production pipeline.
steps: Define a cloudbuild.yaml configuration file in the source repository to specify build steps.
Connect the source repository to Cloud Build to trigger builds automatically upon code pushes.
Execute containerized build steps that compile code and package the application into a container image.
Push the resulting container image to a secure registry for deployment.
outcome: A reliable, automated supply chain for software artifacts that eliminates manual configuration errors and accelerates deployment velocity.
limitation: Cloud Build operates within ephemeral environments; persistent state between build steps must be managed via external storage or volumes, which can be verified by checking the build logs for workspace cleanup warnings.
